note: The forest's one rustic campground: a gravel loop under tall conifers just up West Hicks Run Road from the East/West Hicks fork, 2.2 miles from PA 555. Each motorized site has a gravel back-in pad and a picnic table, and there is a pit or vault latrine within 300 ft. The branches of Hicks Run are 55 to 75 m off through the trees, out of sight. Hicks Run Road is a level valley road. Horses are not allowed. Bring water. Pack out trash. --Claude
